description: TomTom Maps lets users search for places and addresses, plan routes with live traffic, check traffic incidents, and explore results on interactive maps. It supports geocoding and reverse geocoding, point-of-interest discovery with category lookup, area and along-route search, reachable-range analysis, EV charging search and route planning, and visualization of custom GeoJSON data on a TomTom basemap.

defaultPrompt: Plan my drive from Amsterdam to Brussels this afternoon and tell me what traffic looks like on the way.
Find Italian restaurants near Dam Square in Amsterdam and show them on a map.
Show me how far I can drive from Rotterdam Centraal in 30 minutes, and which supermarkets fall inside that area.
